title: Options for what to do on ctrl-click
line: The Task Manager has a new "Ctrl+clicking grouped task" setting, so Ctrl+click can open the window list or previews while a normal click still cycles through windows.
explanation: The Task Manager had a single setting for what clicking a grouped task does, and Ctrl+click went through the same code path, so it always did the same thing. The old Ctrl+click behaviour was a hidden leftover that was removed on purpose, and Nate said it could come back as a deliberate configurable option. The change adds a "Ctrl+clicking grouped task" combo box below "Clicking grouped task" with the same four actions plus "Does the same as clicking" (the default, so nothing changes for existing users); activateTask() picks that action when Ctrl is held.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: add an option for what Ctrl+clicking a grouped task does

Ctrl+clicking a grouped task always did the same as clicking it, so there
was no way to, for example, cycle through windows on click and still get a
textual list or window previews. Add a setting that picks the action for it.

BUG: 437793

media.caption: Behavior settings on master: only "Clicking grouped task", nothing for Ctrl+click.

Master, clicking set to cycle: Ctrl+clicking the grouped Konsole button just switches to the next window.
With Ctrl+click set to "Shows textual list", Ctrl+clicking the same button opens the window list.
